stages.change_vs_old: Old 1. Marked out of v3 scope.

stages.definition: First project (App ID) exists. Auto-provisioned at signup, not a user decision. Greyed: excluded from step conversion. Out of v3 scope.
stages.source: Console project service on appid create. v3 has no project object; appid is a path param only.
stages.change_vs_old: Old 2. Still greyed; marked out of v3 scope.

stages.definition: First saved agent. Deployment type and preset are recorded as intent, never as a deployment.
stages.source: POST /agents 201 via the API gateway emitter (gap G1). Props deployment_type (labels.studio_deployment), preset (labels.studio_preset), source from labels.studio_source console|auto; label missing means api. Console fallback until G1: operation_succeeded {operation: agent_create}. Builder KPIs count source console only.
stages.change_vs_old: Old 4, moved ahead of old 3: a v3 test session needs agent_id and Concept A creates first. source now comes from a Studio label, since the server cannot tell Studio from API callers.

stages.aha: Aha 1: the preset agent answers before any edit.
stages.definition: First answer heard in a test session on an agent unchanged since create. Voice only; simulation never counts. First only.
stages.source: First agent_audio_heard {turnCount ≥ 1, trigger ≠ auto, configuredByUser false, surface builder} on a session Studio started (id stored by Studio, client_reference studio_test:). Server anchor notif 112 once G3 ships.
stages.change_vs_old: Old 3. Moved after agent_created. Optional: many builders edit before the first test.

stages.definition: First saved change to instructions, greeting or a model versus the preset. First-only milestone; every later save is agent_updated. Voice alone, Advanced tuning and any deployment never count.
stages.source: First agent_updated (server, every PATCH /agents 200, prop fields) whose instructions, greeting or a model differ from the labels.studio_preset defaults. Console fallback: operation_succeeded {operation: agent_update} plus a client diff. PATCH /sessions/{id} never counts.
stages.change_vs_old: Old 5. First only; repeats move to agent_updated so the fix loop is computable. 'Channel bound' removed from configuredByUser.

stages.definition: First module (ASR, LLM, TTS, MLLM or avatar) switched to BYOK.
stages.source: POST or PATCH /agents where any module credential.mode = byok (raw key or $secrets.<set>.<key>); or the first POST /sessions/ephemeral body with byok, once per account, agent_source ephemeral. Prop module. POST /secrets alone never fires it. Client twin credential_mode_changed {module, entryPoint}.
stages.change_vs_old: Old 6 credentials_added renamed: ModelCredential exists in managed mode too. entry moved to the client twin: a server event cannot see the Console surface.

stages.definition: First MCP server or tool attached to the agent: it gives the agent context or actions. First only; attached means saved, not proven working. Never a deployment, never web SDK.
stages.source: POST or PATCH /agents where llm.mcp_servers[], llm.tools[] or mllm.mcp_servers[] goes from empty to non-empty; or the first POST /sessions/ephemeral body carrying them, once per account, agent_source ephemeral. Props integration_type mcp|tool (kb and app reserved, no emitter), count. Every add fires client integration_added. Console fallback: operation_succeeded {operation: integration_attach}.
stages.change_vs_old: Old 8. Meaning corrected from web SDK, iframe, embed to MCP server and tool (knowledge base and app integrations reserved). Moved ahead of Aha 2: the integration list sits before the test. Never merged with channel_connected; connection_created retired.

stages.aha: Aha 2: I hear the agent I built, integrations included.
stages.definition: First answer heard in a test session after stage 5. TTFA stop. First only; every later heard answer is agent_audio_heard. Talk to agent counts here, never as production.
stages.source: First agent_audio_heard {turnCount ≥ 1, trigger ≠ auto, configuredByUser true, surface builder|agent_page|session_detail|history_empty} on a session Studio started.
stages.change_vs_old: Old 7. Now the TTFA stop and the check behind Test before Go live. Surface enum extended to every Talk to agent door.

stages.definition: First deployment for the agent, any type: a number points at it, a run is created, or its first code session starts. Never an integration.
stages.source: inbound: POST or PATCH /numbers setting inbound.agent. batch: POST /campaigns {agent_id} accepted, status scheduled or running. code: first POST /sessions {agent_id} Studio did not start (developer sessions included, provisional until a purpose field ships); POST /sessions/ephemeral fires once per account, agent_source ephemeral. deployment_type read from the endpoint, never from labels. Needs G1; Console fallback operation_succeeded {telephony_phone_number_bind | telephony_campaign_create}; code has no Console fallback. Client twins go_live_clicked, code_snippet_copied.
stages.change_vs_old: Old 10. The only Deployment stage. Absorbs code and web SDK (an rtc transport under a code session), wrongly filed under app_connected in the taxonomy review. Old 9 agent_publish removed: a v3 agent has no deployment state.

stages.aha: Aha 3: the agent answers through its deployment, outside Studio.
stages.definition: First production session on the agent where it answered a person. The creator's own session counts. TTFDA stop.
stages.source: session_ended (server, gap G2) for this agent_id, not Studio-started, status stopped, end_reason not idle timeout, duration_s > effective idle_timeout_ms (default 30 s) + 15 s; ≥ 1 agent turn once turn_count ships. batch interim: run counts.completed ≥ 1, provisional (may include voicemail). inbound and code: unmeasurable until G2 (list rows carry no session id or duration; agent_id join key to confirm).
stages.change_vs_old: Old 11 agent_tested_production renamed ('test' is locked to Studio sessions). Proxy raised above the idle timeout: the old 20 s passed empty RTC sessions.

stages.aha: Proof: someone other than the creator talked to it.
stages.definition: First production session with ≥ 2 turns whose caller is not the creator: inbound caller number not the creator's; code subscriber not a Studio test uid. Saved agents only. Batch unfired until turn count ships.
stages.source: session_ended {turn_count ≥ 2, caller_is_creator false} (G2), both fields unbuilt. Interim, provisional, inbound and code only: production sessions over the stage 10 threshold on 2 distinct days.
stages.change_vs_old: New stage split from Aha 3, so 'called my own number, no outside callers' shows as a drop-off. Batch excluded: its interim 10 and 11 were the same signal.

stages.definition: Owner opens a production session from the agent page, Logs, history or a deep link. Starts the fix loop.
stages.source: session_opened on a session Studio did not start, after GET /sessions/{id} 200; props surface agent_page|logs|history|deep_link. From lists only once SessionListItem returns agent_session_id (G4); deep links and stored ids work today. Ephemeral not separable until origin ships.
stages.change_vs_old: New. Replaces event-spec call_reviewed. 'Production' means not Studio-started until origin ships.

stages.definition: Payment method on file. plan_selected returns as a prop only if plans ship.
stages.source: Billing service card saved (outside v3 API, gap G9); client twin add_card_clicked.
stages.change_vs_old: Old 12 plan_selected or card_added, now one event: pricing flat per 24 Sep call B.

stages.definition: Free minutes exhausted with no card, or payment failed: new sessions refused, production agents silent. Exhaustion with a card rolls into billing and is not risk.
stages.source: Billing state suspended {reason free_minutes_exhausted|payment_failed, production_agents_silenced} (G9). Precursors, not stages: free_minutes_warning at 80 %, free_minutes_exhausted {has_card}. Console sees ErrorResponse reason AccountSuspended on refused sessions (test_refused {reason suspended}).
stages.change_vs_old: Old 13. free_minutes_exhausted becomes a precursor and a reason; 80 % warning added.

stages.source: Billing state suspended to active {hours_suspended}; confirmed by the next accepted POST /sessions or inbound session.

stages.definition: First billed minute past free minutes, from a production or ephemeral session.
stages.source: Metering service first billable minute carrying agent_session_id, so minutes join to agents and to Studio's test ids; props deployment_type, ephemeral. Test minutes billed but flagged.

stages.definition: Account has production sessions on ≥ 7 distinct days in the 30 days after first_paid_minute. Observed, not moved by any v3 feature. RPA is the agent-level KPI.
stages.source: Daily job over billing usage by day, test-flagged minutes excluded.
stages.change_vs_old: Old 16. Definition fixed (≥ 7 distinct days in 30); marked observed.

vocabulary.never: app (alone), connection, connector, plugin, add-on; 'integrate' for SDK or code work
vocabulary.means: MCP server, tool, knowledge base or app integration attached to an agent: gives it context or actions. Group Integration, event key app_connected. Never a deployment.
Third-party app giving an agent context (HubSpot in the current Console). Not in the v3 spec; integration_type app reserved. WhatsApp is never one.
One mcp_servers[] entry: endpoint, headers, allowed_tools, timeout_ms. Its transport field is the MCP wire protocol, never a session transport.

vocabulary.never: function, custom function, action; webhook as a synonym for tool
vocabulary.means: One llm.tools[] entry: an HTTP call the LLM can make.
Documents the agent retrieves from. Not in the v3 spec; integration_type kb reserved; no row ships that cannot save.
NCS event delivery set on the Webhooks page. Setting one never fires app_connected.
How production sessions reach an agent. Lives on a number, run or session, never on the agent. Group Deployment, event key channel_connected. Builder area: Deployment.

vocabulary.never: channel type, agent type, mode, modality
vocabulary.means: inbound, batch or code; WhatsApp reserved. Picked at create, stored in labels.studio_deployment. Prop deployment_type (server), deploymentType (client).
Deployment type: a number whose inbound.agent is this agent. Also a direction value.

vocabulary.never: outbound (as a type), bulk calling, campaign (as a type)
vocabulary.means: Deployment type: the agent dials a contact list over telephony. Never inbound.

vocabulary.never: SDK, web SDK, embed, iframe, widget, app, API channel
vocabulary.means: Deployment type: the customer's software starts sessions with POST /sessions over rtc or telephony. Web SDK is an rtc transport here.
Session property inbound or outbound, from the endpoint (number inbound; run or code telephony outbound; rtc none). 'Outbound' only as a direction value.
The action inside Deployment: point a number, start a run or copy the snippet. Leads to channel_connected.
E.164 number with SIP trunk and inbound routing (/numbers). Page: Numbers. 'Transports' is internal only (digest §9).

vocabulary.never: campaign (for one execution), batch job, blast
vocabulary.means: One API Campaign: contact list, calling windows, pacing, status. 'Campaign' reserved for a grouping v3 lacks.
Weekday time range a run may dial (schedule.days).
One door: New run sheet prefilled with the contact list Studio stored.
Session field rtc or telephony (WhatsApp later). A property, never a stage. Detail cards are transport cards.
sip_trunk.transport (udp, tcp, tls) on a number.
Agora RTC channel name inside an rtc transport. The only UI use of 'channel'.
One conversation between an agent and a person on any transport. 'Call' only inside API names (call_policy).
A session Studio starts (test panel, Talk to agent), id stored by Studio, client_reference studio_test:. Never production.
Any session on a saved agent that Studio did not start; developer sessions included until a purpose field ships.
Session status running (API). Agent page section: Running now.
First agent utterance heard. TTFA and TTFDA stop. TTFAB is runtime latency, a different metric.

vocabulary.never: successful call, real call, verified call
vocabulary.means: Production session with ≥ 2 turns whose caller is not the creator.

vocabulary.never: temporary agent, inline agent, anonymous session
vocabulary.means: POST /sessions/ephemeral with the agent defined in the request, no agent_id. Listed; never in agent aggregates.
data_policy.retention none: row, count and cost kept, content never stored. Row tag: Zero retention.
Content past 30-day retention; the row stays.
Saved pipeline picked at create: Lowest latency, Balanced. Custom means no preset.
Differs from its preset in instructions, greeting or a model.
Provider key in a secret set (/secrets), referenced as $secrets.<set>.<key>. Documented for model api_key and SIP password only.

vocabulary.never: own keys, custom keys, Agora keys, byo
vocabulary.means: credential.mode values: byok uses the customer's key, managed uses Agora's.
Text scenario run. Never counts toward any Aha.
Errors of one cause on one agent with their sessions (Logs). Badge: '2 errors · 3 warnings' in the header, '2 errors' on the list.
Free allowance before billing. Warn at 80 %, exhausted at 100 %.
The one banner for free minutes left, suspension and reactivation.
Account state: new sessions refused, production agents silent. 'Paused' is a run status only.
Agent-level success criteria and fields (API structured_output, named in a tooltip).
appid scope. 'App ID' only as the literal field label.
Saved config from POST /agents. Has no deployment state.

kpis.name: Fast-Proven Rate (FPR), north star
kpis.target: ≥ 18 % of console-created saved agents per weekly cohort, read 14 d after the cohort week; validate against a 2-week W0 baseline. 45 % only with the raised inputs in the FPR decision.
kpis.formula: builder_opened to agent_tested_configured ≤ 15 active min AND agent_proven ≤ 14 d of agent_created, share of agent_created {source console}. Arithmetic: fast test 0.60 × Go live ≤ 7 d 0.60 × answered ≤ 3 d 0.80 × proven by day 14 0.65 = 0.19. Reported per deployment type; batch excluded until turn count ships; provisional while G2 is open.
kpis.counter: Test before Go live ≥ 85 %; RPA reported beside it
kpis.why: Revenue is per minute; fast proof predicts agents that stay in production.

kpis.name: TTFA, time to first answer
kpis.target: Median ≤ 3 min, p75 ≤ 6 min
kpis.formula: builder_opened to agent_tested_configured, active time (idle > 120 s removed), winsorised 900 s, source console
kpis.counter: VTR (agent_created to agent_tested_configured ≤ 14 d) ≥ 70 %
kpis.why: Build loop speed; presets exist to cut it.

kpis.name: TTFDA, time to first deployed answer
kpis.target: Active part median ≤ 2× TTFA median (≤ 6 min), p75 ≤ 12 min. Wall-clock part median: inbound ≤ 10 min; batch ≤ 15 min; code snippet to first session ≤ 30 min.
kpis.formula: Active: builder_opened to go_live_clicked, same active clock, winsorised 1800 s. Wall clock, per deployment_type: inbound channel_connected to agent_answered_production; batch Campaign.started_at to agent_answered_production; code code_snippet_copied to channel_connected {code}.
kpis.counter: Test before Go live ≥ 85 %; the active part must not grow when TTFA drops
kpis.why: Go live must cost no more than building did; the wait after Go live is reported, not hidden by an idle clock.

kpis.name: Test before Go live
kpis.target: ≥ 85 % absolute floor
kpis.formula: channel_connected with a heard test answer (agent_audio_heard, baseline or configured) on the agent version at Go live (agentVersion = updated_at after the last agent_updated), share of channel_connected {source console}
kpis.counter: TTFDA active part
kpis.why: Stops speed wins that skip the test; version-aware so an edit after the test does not count as tested.

kpis.name: Create completion
kpis.target: ≥ 90 % of create sheet opens
kpis.formula: create_sheet_opened to agent_created, share
kpis.counter: deployment_type_changed before the first deployment ≤ 10 % of agents
kpis.why: Tests that deployment type belongs at create.

kpis.name: Preset keep rate
kpis.formula: channel_connected with preset unchanged and Custom never opened, share of channel_connected {source console, agent_source saved}
kpis.counter: Custom abandoned unsaved ≤ 10 % of Custom opens
kpis.why: Tests that presets fit most use cases.

kpis.name: BYOK key works
kpis.formula: secret_saved {entryPoint builder} to the next agent_audio_heard on that agent with no byok_key_failed for that module, share
kpis.counter: credential_page_exited per new agent ≤ 0.2
kpis.why: The spec has no key check; a saved key is not a working key.

kpis.name: Tested integration rate
kpis.formula: integration_added to agent_audio_heard on the same agent ≤ 24 h, share of integration_added
kpis.counter: integration_removed ≤ 24 h ≤ 15 %
kpis.why: No health field or execution log; a heard test is the only proof an integration works.

kpis.name: Integration value (assumption)
kpis.target: Agents with an integration reach agent_proven at ≥ 1.3× (14 d read) and RPA at ≥ 1.5× (60 d read) the rate of agents without; kill below 1.1× at 14 d
kpis.formula: agent_created cohort split by app_connected present and integration_type, stratified by deployment_type and account size
kpis.counter: Production sessions with an integration error ≤ 2 % (blocked on the RTM stream)
kpis.why: Decides whether the knowledge base and app integrations earn a build; the 14 d read comes before the 60 d one.

kpis.name: Go live rate
kpis.target: ≥ 60 % within 7 d of the first configured test; batch ≥ 70 %
kpis.formula: agent_tested_configured to channel_connected ≤ 7 d, share by deployment_type, source console
kpis.counter: Stalled deployments (stage 9, no stage 10 within 3 d) ≤ 20 %; runs canceled in first 10 min ≤ 10 %
kpis.why: An agent that never goes live earns nothing.

kpis.name: Proven after production answer
kpis.target: ≥ 65 % by day 14 of create (inbound, code)
kpis.formula: agent_answered_production to agent_proven, both ≤ 14 d of agent_created, share; batch excluded until turn count ships
kpis.counter: Production sessions under 45 s ≤ 15 %
kpis.why: The gap between the creator's own session and outside callers is where revenue dies.

kpis.name: SAR, second-agent rate
kpis.target: ≥ 25 % of accounts at agent_proven create a second agent ≤ 28 d
kpis.formula: agent_proven (account's first) to a second agent_created {source console} ≤ 28 d, share of accounts
kpis.counter: Second agents never tested ≤ 20 %
kpis.why: The business is expansion-led; no other KPI measures it. Go live rate and TTFDA replace SBDR.

kpis.name: Error acknowledgement time
kpis.target: Median ≤ 24 h
kpis.formula: first session_ended {status failed} or new error group on an agent to error_group_opened or logs_opened for that agent, median
kpis.counter: Errors unopened at 7 d ≤ 10 %
kpis.why: Logs and the error badge exist for this. Blocked on the RTM stream and G2.

kpis.name: Error badge follow-through
kpis.target: ≥ 50 % of agent page visits with an open error group
kpis.formula: agent_page_opened {errorState errors} to error_group_opened in the same visit, share
kpis.counter: Badge opens leaving Logs in < 5 s ≤ 30 %
kpis.why: Ties the agent page to fixing, not to visits.

kpis.name: Talk to agent follow-through
kpis.target: ≥ 40 % of Talk to agent sessions
kpis.formula: talk_to_agent_started to agent_updated or error_group_quiet on that agent ≤ 24 h, share
kpis.counter: agent_updated reverted ≤ 24 h ≤ 10 %
kpis.why: A re-check only matters if it leads to a fix or confirms one.

kpis.name: Card before exhaustion
kpis.target: ≥ 50 % of warned accounts
kpis.formula: free_minutes_warning to card_added before free_minutes_exhausted, share
kpis.counter: minutes_banner_dismissed ≤ 30 %
kpis.why: Keeps production agents from going silent.

kpis.name: Suspension recovery
kpis.target: ≥ 60 % reactivated ≤ 24 h
kpis.formula: account_suspended to account_reactivated ≤ 24 h, share
kpis.counter: Accounts with no production session in the 30 d after reactivation ≤ 10 %
kpis.why: Every suspended hour on a production agent is lost minutes.

kpis.name: Free to paid
kpis.target: ≥ 25 % of accounts at agent_proven within 30 d (to validate)
kpis.formula: agent_proven to first_paid_minute ≤ 30 d, share of accounts
kpis.counter: Accounts suspended before their first paid minute ≤ 20 %
kpis.why: Direct revenue conversion.

kpis.name: Retained Production Agents (RPA)
kpis.target: ≥ 25 % of agents at agent_proven retained within 60 d (to validate)
kpis.formula: agent_proven to ≥ 20 production sessions in each of 4 consecutive weeks ≤ 60 d, share
kpis.counter: Share of retained agents' sessions from the account's own numbers ≤ 10 %
kpis.why: Companion north star; the line the per-minute business earns on.

kpis.name: Sustained usage
kpis.target: ≥ 35 % of paying accounts (to validate); observed, no v3 feature moves it
kpis.formula: first_paid_minute to sustained_usage_30d, share of accounts
kpis.counter: Paid minutes on failed sessions ≤ 2 %
kpis.why: Account-level revenue retention.

kpis.name: Time to the session
kpis.target: Median ≤ 60 s
kpis.formula: history_opened to session_opened (any origin), then link_copied, session_downloaded or talk_to_agent_started ≤ 2 min, median
kpis.counter: Misses (opened, left in < 5 s) ≤ 20 %
kpis.why: History is for drill down, not aggregation; covers test and ephemeral lookups too.

kpis.name: Change after diagnosis
kpis.target: ≥ 30 % within 24 h (to validate)
kpis.formula: session_reviewed on a failed session or from an error group to agent_updated on that agent ≤ 24 h, share
kpis.counter: agent_updated reverted ≤ 24 h ≤ 10 %
kpis.why: Closes the fix loop; uses the repeatable agent_updated, not first-only stage 5.

kpis.name: Honest rows
kpis.target: Listed session minutes = invoiced minutes ± 1 %, monthly
kpis.formula: billed minutes by agent_session_id vs history rows (incl. zero retention, ephemeral), monthly ratio; needs billable_seconds on sessions
kpis.counter: Billing tickets about missing sessions = 0 (ticket system per decision)
kpis.why: Count and cost always, content never.

kpis.name: API parity
kpis.target: 100 % of 201 spec leaf fields settable in Console or on the approved API-only list with a reason; renames only Analysis and run
kpis.formula: Parity script run on each spec version: leaf field to Console control or API-only entry
kpis.counter: Advanced panel opened by ≤ 30 % of new agents
kpis.why: v3 API calls must round-trip in Studio.

kpis.name: Unassigned numbers
kpis.target: 0 numbers without inbound.agent for > 7 d, excluding numbers used as a run's from number in the last 30 d
kpis.formula: Daily job over GET /numbers joined to GET /campaigns transport.from, count of misses
kpis.counter: Numbers re-pointed within 24 h of Go live ≤ 10 %
kpis.why: A number with no agent is a dead deployment; run numbers are healthy without one.

kpis.name: Safe secret replace
kpis.target: Agents broken by a secret replace = 0
kpis.formula: PUT /secrets/{name} to session_ended {status failed, provider-auth error} ≤ 24 h on agents in labels.studio_secret_sets, count; API-created agents reported as unknown coverage
kpis.counter: Secrets page visits per new agent ≤ 0.2
kpis.why: DELETE is refused while referenced; PUT replaces the whole set and can drop a referenced key.

journeys.who: Every builder before any deployment; funnel-only, no step journey
journeys.path: 1, 2, 3, [4], 5, [6], [7], 8; repeats run on agent_updated and agent_audio_heard, not stages

journeys.name: Integration
journeys.who: Builder attaching an MCP server or tool; deployment untouched

journeys.name: Code in Studio
journeys.who: Developers starting sessions from their software over rtc or telephony

journeys.name: API-only, saved agent
journeys.who: Developers who create and deploy through the v3 API and never test in Studio; funnel-only; unmeasured until G1

journeys.name: Ephemeral only
journeys.who: Developers defining the agent in each session request; account level only; unmeasured until G1

journeys.name: Stalled at Go live (rainy)
journeys.who: Number pointed or run created, no production answer within 3 d

journeys.name: Stalled after own session (rainy)
journeys.who: Creator dialled their own number; no outside caller by day 14; funnel-only

journeys.name: Free minutes run out (rainy)
journeys.who: Production agent hits zero free minutes with no card

journeys.name: Code first session fails (rainy)
journeys.who: Developer whose first POST /sessions fails or ends empty

journeys.name: Ephemeral session fails (rainy)
journeys.who: Developer debugging a failed ephemeral session
journeys.path: none; account level, history and secrets only

journeys.name: Fix loop
journeys.who: Owner of a production agent after an error badge or a bad session

journeys.name: Fix with nothing to read (rainy)
journeys.who: Owner whose error stream is down, content not stored, or BYOK key revoked

journeys.name: Integration saved, not working (rainy)
journeys.who: Builder whose MCP server or tool fails in a test or in production

features.title: Choose how people reach it
features.step: Sam decides how people will reach the agent: they dial its number, it dials a list of people, or the team's own software starts the conversation.

happy.story: Sam wants to create a new agent that fits how people will reach it, so no setup time goes on things that do not apply.
steps: Sam opens Create agent from the Agents list.
Sam types a name and picks one of three type cards: inbound, batch or code. Each card has one line of copy.
Sam presses Create. The agent saves on Lowest latency with labels studio_deployment, studio_preset and studio_source.
The builder opens on Voice & models and shows only what that type needs.

rainy.title: Sam picked the wrong type
rainy.recovery: Before the first deployment, the type changes in place. After it, a dialog names the number or run that holds the agent.

rainy.title: The agent was made through the API and has no type
rainy.recovery: Studio asks for the type once and suggests one from the number or run pointing at the agent.

rainy.title: Create fails (400, 429)
rainy.recovery: The sheet keeps the name and type, shows the error code and offers retry.

rainy.title: Sam wants WhatsApp or a web page
rainy.recovery: WhatsApp is reserved and not offered. The code card says that web and app sessions use code over rtc.

rainy.title: The connection drops while saving
rainy.recovery: Create locks while saving. Before a retry, Studio re-reads the agents list so a second agent is never made.

rainy.title: Sam leaves the name empty
rainy.recovery: Create stays off, with one line explaining why. Studio never invents a name.

rainy.title: Sam closes the sheet partway through
rainy.recovery: Nothing is saved and no draft agent appears in the list. The sheet opens empty next time.

monitoring.thesis: Monitoring is one graph: every object has a URL, every count opens the sessions behind it or says why not, and every step from agent to log line and back keeps range, filters and a named way home.
principles: Aggregate on the agent (and a run's own API counts), never on session history; history shows a row count only and links up to the agent's numbers.

Every number opens the sessions behind it with the same range and filters (Agora's own rule; LangSmith and ElevenLabs are the nearest precedents). If the API cannot serve it yet, the number stays visible, disabled, with one line on why.
Every object has a URL, including panels (session, turn, log line) and derived objects (error group key <module_name>:<event_type>).
Every down pivot has a named way back: breadcrumb, scope chip, parent chip or return chip, plus a reliable Back.
Pivots narrow, never reset: going down adds one filter or overlay, going up removes it; one published key table for every level.
Inspect in a panel, own in a page: the list you came from stays underneath, untouched when you close (Retell and Vapi slide-over with chevrons and X).
Every chain ends in a confirmed change: a log line, turn or error group opens the exact setting, then Talk to agent and 'Sessions since this change with this error' show whether it came back.
Rainy states are named: unavailable is never zero, processing is never unavailable, expired is never not found, zero retention is never empty, an unlinked agent is never guessed.
Never join on agent_name: attribution to a saved agent comes only from an id (API, v2 source or the Studio session registry); otherwise the row reads 'Agent not linked'.
One component per level wherever it appears: the same session list on agent Overview, error group, run, number and history.
Selection shows in place: the chosen turn or line is highlighted with its neighbours visible, never isolated in a modal.

context_rules: Key table (one set, every level): range (24h, 7d, 30d; 90d only after the API states its lookback), from, to, widen, env (production, test, all), agent, run, number, contact, group, status, severity, module, type, direction, transport, origin, retention, new, sort, tab, q, view, via, in, session, turn, log, t, project. A level ignores keys it does not apply but keeps them in the URL, so Back restores them.

Carry rules: down pivots add one filter or overlay (from/to, widen) and a scope chip; up pivots remove the leaf and keep the rest; tab switches keep range, env, run and status and drop tab-only keys (severity, module) from display while keeping them in history.
Removing a scope chip widens the list; the breadcrumb is the way up a level.

Every tile, bucket, badge and segment pivot writes env=production. History defaults to env=all with Test tags (PRD decision 24). Recent sessions shows production plus a 'Your tests (n)' door; 'Sessions since this change' carries env=all.

Error badge unit: error groups with at least one error-severity production occurrence in range (quiet groups included and tagged); the landed Logs list under the same range and severity shows exactly that many rows; countShown rides the pivot.

Single-object pivots keep the parent range in the URL. Bucket, run-window and contact pivots are overlays with a 'Back to 7 days' chip. Up pivots from a pasted link widen the default range to include the object and say so.

Breadcrumbs are built from structural parents plus via= (agents, overview, analytics, group, run, number, config). Run: Agents / <agent> / Runs / <run>. Number: Numbers / <E.164>. A session with no proven agent: Sessions / <id>.
Back is reliable: opening a panel, turn or log pushes a history entry; Back or Esc closes the innermost; lists restore filters, sort, scroll and a 2 s row highlight.

Pages for durable objects; panels for inspection. One panel at a time: a deeper panel replaces the current one with '‹ <parent>'. in= names the list the panel steps through (group, run, number, recent, list); ↑ and ↓ follow it and 'Exit full screen' returns to it, else /sessions.
Arriving with turn=, log= or t= selects, scrolls, seeks and highlights with neighbours visible.

Deep links: /agents · /agents/:id · /agents/:id/analytics · /agents/:id/logs · /agents/:id/logs/:groupKey · /agents/:id/runs · /agents/:id/edit · /logs · /logs/:groupKey · /runs/:id · /numbers/:id · /sessions · /sessions/:id; old /agents/:id?rail=, /telephony/campaigns/:id and /agent-analytics?tab= redirect with every param kept; old group keys redirect to successors.
Copy link writes absolute from and to, project, and agent, run, number from the copier's context; a relative range is never written.
Return chip accepts only same-origin monitoring paths; unsaved builder edits ask Save or Discard; nesting stops at two levels (secret set returns to the builder, the builder returns to the source).
A pivot the API cannot serve stays visible, disabled, with one line on why (api_gap, processing, zero_retention, ephemeral, not_linked, expired, role, no_access); never hidden, never a broken link.

Retention matrix per block (metadata, transcript, recording, Analysis, events, latency) confirmed with the API team under decision 6; until then 'Retention unknown' is the default for sessions Studio did not start.
History facets carry no counts; per-facet numbers live on the agent's Analytics.
Studio session registry: a Console-backend store keyed by appid + agent_session_id holding agent_id, surface, test flag and retention for sessions Studio starts; never browser storage.

kpis.name: Error to root cause
kpis.target: Median ≤ 4 clicks and ≤ 60 s; p75 ≤ 6 clicks and ≤ 120 s; baseline from a timed 5-owner task on the current Console; unmeasurable for sessions without v2 events
kpis.formula: Per visit (visitId, 30 min inactivity): first error_badge_clicked or error_group_opened to first log_line_opened {severity: error} in that group's session. Clicks = monitoring_pivot count; seconds = delta; median over visits that reach it; Session.message never counts. By entry and by source.
kpis.counter: Oscillation ≥ 3 times between two levels ≤ 15 %; log_line_opened left in < 5 s ≤ 30 %

kpis.name: Root cause to setting
kpis.target: ≥ 40 % of error log-line opens reach the exact setting within 10 min; median 1 click
kpis.formula: log_line_opened {severity: error} or turn_selected on a failed leg, to builder_opened {entryPoint: log_line|turn|error_group} on the same proven agent ≤ 10 min, share
kpis.counter: Wrong landing (another builder_section_opened ≤ 60 s) ≤ 20 %; agent_reverted ≤ 24 h ≤ 10 % (server diff returns changed fields to prior values)

kpis.name: Round-trip rate and integrity
kpis.target: Round trip ≥ 60 % of investigation visits (to validate); integrity ≥ 98 %
kpis.formula: Investigation visit = ≥ 1 monitoring_pivot {direction: down, toLevel: session|turn|log}. Direction from a published parent map per level; other pivots are 'across'. Round trip = same visit has an up pivot. Integrity = up pivots with stateRestored / all up pivots.
kpis.counter: time_range_changed or history_filter_changed {action: clear} ≤ 10 s after an up pivot ≤ 10 %

kpis.name: Dead-end rate
kpis.target: ≤ 10 % of level views at launch; ≤ 5 % once G4, G11 and G12 ship; by reason
kpis.formula: dead_end_viewed fires only when a disabled control is clicked or focused, or on landing on a blocked level; share of level views with no further monitoring event in 30 s; reason 'processing' excluded
kpis.counter: Unexplained blanks = 0 (UI audit each release)

kpis.name: Number to sessions
kpis.target: 100 % of counts are links or carry a disabled reason (audit); ≥ 40 % of count clicks reach session_opened in the same visit
kpis.formula: tile_clicked, error_badge_clicked or monitoring_pivot {trigger: count|tile|bucket|segment} to session_opened, same visit
kpis.counter: countShown vs history_opened.rowCount differing by > 5 % without partial=true ≤ 10 %

kpis.name: Link lands
kpis.target: ≥ 95 % of shared links open the exact object and range
kpis.formula: shared_link_opened {access: ok, found: true, rangeKind: absolute} / shared_link_opened
kpis.counter: No-access landings ≤ 5 %; link_copied {rangeKind: relative} = 0

learnings.copy: Error Tracking issue panel: lifecycle up top, samples below with 'direct access to the related trace or to logs'; New and Regression tags; Deployments tab counts error types new in a version; log Trace tab rebuilds the context around one line; View in context shows neighbours even when filtered out.

learnings.copy: Visible breadcrumb (Project / Sessions / id) over sibling session tabs; Transcript · Traces · Logs on one clock with audio playback and scrubbing; latency split into LLM TTFT, TTS TTFB, transcription delay and end-of-turn detection; data may take up to five minutes after a session ends.
learnings.avoid: No agent-to-sessions filter; dispatch errors in a CLI stream; silent rainy states; role-gated insights with no explanation.

learnings.avoid: Donut legends that need an expand before they open sessions; recording links that expire 10 minutes after the webhook without saying so.

umbrellas.name: Agent config
umbrellas.job: Sam wants to create a new agent that people outside the team can talk to.
umbrellas.outcome: An agent Sam heard answer in a test is answering people outside the team, set up in one sitting, and Sam feels sure enough of it to put it in front of them. P1.8 is the step that proves this.
umbrellas.kpi_simple: Median time to first heard answer under 3 minutes.
umbrellas.kpi_detail: North star, Fast-Proven Rate (FPR): at least 18 % of console-created saved agents per weekly cohort, read 14 d after the cohort week. Formula: builder_opened to agent_tested_configured in 15 active min or less, AND agent_proven (derived) within 14 d of agent_created, as a share of agent_created {source console}. The target multiplies out as fast test 0.60 × Go live within 7 d 0.60 × answered within 3 d 0.80 × proven by day 14 0.65 = 0.19. Reported per deployment type. Batch is excluded until turn count ships. Provisional while G2 is open: stages 10 and 11 need session_ended; interim proxy in P1.8. TTFA: median 3 min or less, p75 6 min or less (first builder_opened for the agent to agent_tested_configured, activeMs summed across builder_opened and builder_resumed, idle over 120 s removed, winsorised at 900 s, source console). Counter: VTR at least 70 %. TTFDA: active part median 6 min or less (2× TTFA), p75 12 min or less. Wall-clock median by deployment type: inbound 10 min or less, batch 15 min or less, code snippet to first session 30 min or less (wall clock needs G2; code needs G1). Guard: Test before Go live at least 85 %, version-aware. Emotional criterion: Go live confidence 4.0 / 5 or higher on average (P0.12). No P0 KPI is reported until the P0.13 data-quality checks have been green for 7 days. Validate against a 2-week W0 baseline.

umbrellas.name: Monitoring · Agents
umbrellas.job: Sam wants to know how each agent is doing with people outside the team, and fix what fails before customers notice.
umbrellas.outcome: Sam spots the agent in trouble, reaches the cause in under a minute, removes it and sees the error stop, without losing place.
umbrellas.kpi_simple: Median path from a new error to its cause is at most 4 steps and under a minute.
umbrellas.kpi_detail: Error to root cause: median ≤ 4 steps and ≤ 60 s, p75 ≤ 6 steps and ≤ 120 s. Per visit (visitId, 30 min inactivity): first error_badge_clicked or error_group_opened to first log_line_opened {severity: error} in that group's session; steps = monitoring_pivot count; baseline from a timed 5-owner task on the current Console. Error acknowledgement: median ≤ 24 h (first session_ended {status failed} or new error group to error_group_opened or logs_opened for that agent).
